summary.text: HTS INVEST AS is a private limited company registered in Drammen, founded 1984-10-15. HTS INVEST AS owns shares and participates in other companies. Its main industry code is 25.530: machining of metals. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 11 136 000 NOK and the annual result was 15 496 597 NOK; operating income was down from 12 672 000 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 3 672 659 NOK in 2024 to 15 496 597 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 9 676 938 NOK in 2024 to 20 173 535 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Nina Cecilie Harvik Solberg (daglig leder) and Harald Charles Røste Throndsen (styrets leder), with 5 other board members. The register's most recent update was on 2026-06-11 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
